mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, producing statistically significant positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate drops below 0.25% within one month, it triggers aggressive monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS falls below 0.25% within one month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction condition (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp) occurs but 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained consumer demand for residential construction, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The late-cycle expansion regime is active but 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months reflects robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST trends upward.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% within one month signals a tight labor market that increases household income and spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0% within one month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust supply chain activity and consumer spending on goods, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 1.0% and RSAFS growth > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO growth > 1.0% and RSAFS growth > 0.5%) occurs but 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing output and capital investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The early-cycle expansion regime is active but 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises.
